title: Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array II
summary: Given an array of n prime numbers, construct an array ans of length n where for each index i, the bitwise OR of ans[i] and ans[i] + 1 equals the corresponding prime number in the input array.
statement: Given an array of n prime numbers, construct an array ans of length n where for each index i, the bitwise OR of ans[i] and ans[i] + 1 equals the corresponding prime number in the input array. Minimize each ans[i] value. If no valid ans[i] can be found, set ans[i] to -1.
constraints: nums contains 1–100 prime values between 2 and 1,000,000,000.
For each prime p, find the smallest nonnegative x with x OR (x+1)=p.
reference_solution:
def minimum_bitwise_predecessors(nums):
    answer=[]
    for value in nums:
        if value==2:answer.append(-1);continue
        bit=1
        while value&bit:bit<<=1
        answer.append(value^(bit>>1))
    return answer

hints: x OR (x+1) is always odd and changes the trailing-one structure around x’s lowest zero bit.
For odd p, locate its first zero bit and clear the preceding one bit.
Return -1 for p=2; otherwise scan powers of two while p contains them and XOR the previous bit.
Clearing the highest trailing one makes increment restore the entire run, and clearing any lower bit would produce a larger x.
